name: rungic-codex
description:
Codex launcher for the Plasma desktop
/usr/bin/codex runs the user's official standalone Codex (~/.codex/packages/standalone, installed and
updated from Settings with OpenAI's script) behind the desktop's HTTP proxy (docs/99).
The Codex binaries the package carried up to 0.156.1 are no longer part of the system.
